customrecordtype.recordname: S4VP Nguồn sản lượng từ giao dịch
customrecordtype.description: Output source: generates on-hold output entries from NetSuite production transactions (assembly build, work order completion, item fulfillment). Record name = source ID. Acumatica screen VP308000. Generated by tools/gen_objects.mjs.

customrecordcustomfield.description: Script ID of the body (custbody...) or line (custcol...) field holding the employee (List/Record: Employee).
customrecordcustomfield.help: Script ID of the body (custbody...) or line (custcol...) field holding the employee (List/Record: Employee).

customrecordcustomfield.label: Trường tổ trên giao dịch
customrecordcustomfield.description: Optional script ID of the body (custbody...) or line (custcol...) field holding the team (List/Record: S4VP Tổ đội); lines with a team become team entries.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Optional script ID of the body (custbody...) or line (custcol...) field holding the team (List/Record: S4VP Tổ đội); lines with a team become team entries.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Dấu số lượng (1 / -1)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Multiplier of the transaction line quantity: 1, or -1 for item fulfillments (shipped quantity is negative). Empty: -1 for item fulfillment, 1 otherwise.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Multiplier of the transaction line quantity: 1, or -1 for item fulfillments (shipped quantity is negative). Empty: -1 for item fulfillment, 1 otherwise.

customrecordcustomfield.description: Use the department of the transaction line as the department of the output entry.
customrecordcustomfield.help: Use the department of the transaction line as the department of the output entry.
